text: I bumped into you by a half-stance, probably wouldn't even know who I am, but if I whispered your own name, I'd better still be your spark. Back when I was gasoline, this old tattoo had ran away, didn't care what your mama think, but your name on my arm. Baby, is it spring or is it summer? The guitar sound, don't beat that drum. You hear sometime late at night on your radio, even though you're a million miles away, you're here born in A.P.S.A. and we lived on the glory day so long ago. When you think about me, do you think about Seventeen? Do you think about my OG? Think about the stars in the sky, but in that old melody, sound like a memory, like a soundtrack to a July Saturday night. Oh, spring steam. Oh, spring steam.
